text:
deploy-bot: ALERT: canary-health/eu-west model-serving pool error_rate=3.7% (threshold 2.0%). Rolling window 3m. Auto-rollout paused.

carmen: Paging oncall — seeing the deploy spike. Do we have a kill-switch? :warning:

ravi: on it, checking canary config and routing. preliminary: latency ok but error rate is concentrated on short prompts that hit the new attention patch.

tilly: If error_rate > 3% across 3m we should flip the feature flag and start manual rollback. I can toggle flag now, hold for confirmation.

laura: Confirmed customer impact: a subset of embed/stream calls seeing 500s, ~2% of total requests in eu-west. No major support tickets yet.

carmen: Do the flag flip + rollback in that order. We want traffic shed before reverting binary to avoid further errors.

ravi: Executing flag flip: `curl -X POST https://flags.internal/redwood.canary.attention_patch -d '{"state":"off"}'`

deploy-bot: FLAG CHANGE: redwood.canary.attention_patch set to OFF by ravi at 1758689050.

laura: Starting manual rollback to v2026.03.01 on the canary pool. Runbook step: drain canary, deploy rollback image, validate smoke.

ravi: Running drain command now:```\n/redwood infra drain --cluster=eu-west-canary --grace=30s\n```

tilly: Drain acknowledged, infrastructure showing pod graceful term.

ravi: Kicked rollback: `kubectl set image ds/model-serving model=image:redwood/v2026.03.01 -n eu-west-canary` -> rollout started.

deploy-bot: ROLLBACK: rollout started for eu-west-canary -> target image redwood/v2026.03.01 by ravi at 1758689145. Progress: 3/5 pods updated.

laura: Smoke check plan: 5m sustained <1% error rate, perf within 95th of baseline. I'll run smoke probes and pin a sample prompt set.

carmen: Notify support and account teams: small blip, but prepare a note in case customers ask. Tagging @support-lead for awareness.

laura: Smoke probe results 1m in: error_rate=0.9%, 200s restored on initial probes. Continuing monitoring.

ravi: Rollout progressed to 5/5 pods. All pods running redwood/v2026.03.01.

deploy-bot: ROLLBACK COMPLETE: all canary instances on redwood/v2026.03.01 at 1758689320.

laura: Post-rollback verification: full smoke 5m window shows error_rate=0.3% (baseline 0.2). Latency stable. No traffic shift anomalies.

tilly: I'll re-enable canary metrics alerts after observing for 15m. Leaving feature flag off until we have a patch.

carmen: Customer impact summary for the postmortem: brief increase in 5xxs for eu-west canary (peak ~2% of traffic), no escalations, rollback within ~12m from detection. Action items: revert attention_patch behavior to safe-path, add more targeted canary prompts to smoke set, tighten auto-rollout cooldown.

ravi: I'll open a PR with the patch and a new canary prompt set. Assigning to @laura for eval.

laura: Thanks — I'll validate PR with the smoke harness and schedule a controlled re-rollout once metrics look good.

carmen: Oncall handing back to SRE rotation. I'll post incident summary in #incidents with timelines and start a postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
